title: fix(ui): the action key inventory lists disabledReason
body:
Part of #26619. This is a main-red hotfix for the spec half (#26786). The console half is still the PR that closes the card.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (a test-inventory row, no authoring surface)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `ui/packages/core` 的 `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` 补上一行 `disabledReason`。
- **为什么改：** #26786 给 `ActionSchema` 加了 `disabledReason`，但 objectui 的动作键清单没跟上，`actionKeys.pin.test.ts` 在 main 上报 missing `['disabledReason']`，Test UI 红，所有合并 main 的分支都受影响。
- **风险与回滚：** 一行数据，只影响「是否算未知键」的判断。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts`: `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` gains `'disabledReason'` after `'disabled'`. The list restates every key the spec's `ActionSchema` declares, and #26786 added that key. An action that carries it is no longer counted as having an unknown key.
- `.changeset/26619-action-keys-disabled-reason.md`: `@object-ui/core` patch. (The root `.changeset`, which the changeset gate counts; `ui/.changeset` is the imported objectui directory.)

## Why

`actionKeys.pin.test.ts` compares `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` with the keys of the built `ActionSchema`. Since #26786 merged (`13dc413f`), it fails on `main` with `missing: ['disabledReason']`. That turns Test UI red on `main` (`8eef9a8d`) and on every branch that merges `main`. The failure was reproduced by another card's dev (standing-down comment 6450604330 on PR #26831).

## Verification

- The failure was read on `main` `8eef9a8d`: the pin's `missing` set is `['disabledReason']` and nothing else.
- The UI workspace dependencies are not installed in this container, so the pin was not run locally. CI's Test UI on this head is the check.

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (apart from the maintainer quick-read block).
